root_cause.text: The `spi-ch341` driver incorrectly associated its device-managed resources (the SPI controller and I/O buffers) with the parent USB device (`udev->dev`) instead of the USB interface device (`intf->dev`), preventing these resources from being released when the driver is unbound.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the driver's calls to `devm_spi_alloc_host` and `devm_kzalloc` were modified to pass `&intf->dev` instead of `&udev->dev` to ensure that the allocated resources are tied to the lifetime of the USB interface.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource lifetime management by using the USB interface device for managed SPI host allocation.
intent_record.what: The device pointer passed to devm_spi_alloc_host is changed from &udev->dev to &intf->dev.
intent_record.how: This associates the lifetime of the allocated SPI host with the USB interface rather than the parent USB device, ensuring correct resource release during driver unbind.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use the USB interface device for managed allocation of the receive buffer to ensure proper resource cleanup upon driver unbind.
intent_record.what: Changed the device pointer passed to devm_kzalloc from the USB device (&udev->dev) to the USB interface device (&intf->dev).
intent_record.how: Binds the lifetime of the allocated rx_buf memory to the USB interface instead of the USB device, ensuring the memory is automatically freed when the interface is unbound.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use the USB interface device for managed memory allocation to ensure correct resource lifetime and cleanup.
intent_record.what: The memory allocation for ch341->tx_buf is changed to use the USB interface device (&intf->dev) instead of the USB device (&udev->dev), while reformatting the assignment to a single line.
intent_record.how: This binds the lifetime of the allocated buffer to the USB interface rather than the USB device, ensuring proper resource cleanup when the driver is unbound from the interface.
